## 10. tools/v2/hot_lint.py: `crates` as a tuple (required, the lint fails without it)

- What: declare the input's `crates` field as `tuple[str, ...]` (default the `HOT` tuple)
  in place of `list[str]`, and skip a file whose first item is `#![cfg(test)]` as a
  `#[cfg(test)]` block is skipped.
- Where: `tools/v2/hot_lint.py`, its input dataclass.
- Why: `typed_input` refuses a `list[str]` field ("crates has a type it does not read"), so
  `{"root": ".", "crates": ["blaze-build-script"]}` fails before reading a file. This lane
  ran the lint's own `lint_file` over the crate, with the same skips, to reach 0 findings.

> forwarded to the coordinator (`tools/`), listed in requests' report.

history.note: tools/v2/hot_lint.py: Input.crates is tuple[str, ...] (any name under crates/ or a path from the root; a missing crate or a run reading no file exits 2); a test cfg is any predicate only test/fuzz builds set (test, all(test, ..), any(test, feature = "fuzz"), fuzzing); files of out-of-line #[cfg(test)] mod x; (and their submodule dirs) and #[path] sources from tests/ are skipped, as is a file under #![cfg(test)]; comments and string/raw-string/char literals are blanked over the whole file (multi-line too) before both the brace count and the checks; \bvec!\[ so smallvec! is not a fresh Vec; HOT gains vendor/salsa, vendor/salsa-macros, vendor/salsa-macro-rules and fuzz (fuzz/targets stays unread, as tests are), blaze-diagnostics was already in; blaze-tier (no such crate) dropped.
